# AI Ready Vancouver

> A free, independent project that checks whether well-reviewed Vancouver small businesses can actually be found and understood by AI assistants like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude, not just traditional search engines.

## What this is

AI Ready Vancouver runs a real AI-readiness audit (based on Google's Lighthouse Agentic Browsing scoring, plus direct checks against AI assistants) on Vancouver businesses, then sends a free, plain-English report. It is not a sales pitch: the report is free to use with this project, a competitor, or nobody at all.

## Who runs this

Built and operated by two tech professionals based in Vancouver, Canada, as a hands-on way to understand how AI agents read the web.

## Topics this project relates to

AI search optimization, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), AI readiness audits, AI-readable business information, ChatGPT/Gemini/Claude/Perplexity visibility for local businesses, local SEO in Vancouver, British Columbia.

## Key pages

- Homepage (https://aireadyvan.ca/): explains the audit, walks through a real example, and includes a free-check request form
- AI discoverability guide (https://aireadyvan.ca/ai-discoverability-guide/): a free, general-purpose technical checklist for making any website discoverable by AI assistants and AI search crawlers, not specific to Vancouver
- AI readiness Vancouver (https://aireadyvan.ca/ai-readiness-vancouver/): explains what "AI readiness" means, why it's distinct from local SEO, and why it matters for Vancouver businesses specifically
- AI search optimization Vancouver (https://aireadyvan.ca/ai-search-optimization-vancouver/): what AI search optimization covers and how ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Claude each source answers differently
- GEO Vancouver (https://aireadyvan.ca/geo-vancouver/): explains Generative Engine Optimization, how it differs from SEO and AEO, and what makes content more citable in AI-generated answers
- ChatGPT optimization Vancouver (https://aireadyvan.ca/chatgpt-optimization-vancouver/): explains OpenAI's three real crawlers (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User) and what each one means for a business site
- AI SEO Vancouver (https://aireadyvan.ca/ai-seo-vancouver/): a combined checklist covering both classic SEO and AI readiness side by side
- AI audit Vancouver (https://aireadyvan.ca/ai-audit-vancouver/): explains exactly what happens during the free audit process and what the report contains
- Contact section (https://aireadyvan.ca/#contact): businesses can request their own free AI-readiness check
- Full page content (https://aireadyvan.ca/llms-full.txt): complete plain-text version of the homepage, including the 4 real checks, current audit stats, and full FAQ
